description: SP judge persona sentences (Methods, 'Trait pairs and judges'). '{a}' is the animal; plurals are formed by appending 's' exactly as written (e.g. 'cuttlefishs'). Wording 0 is the training instance; wordings 1-7 are the further judge instances used for emission and the instance-common part of absorption.
